title: Magonia people arrested at Lyon, Agobard denies it

tellings.quote: where the whole Monagonia thing that Valet talks about. This is that period where you know you had these people supposedly coming from Mononia and some of them were arrested and then this bishop Agabard who was like a protorationalist came up with a justification for why this couldn't possibly be real.

plain: In medieval Lyon, in France, people said to have come from Magonia, a legendary land in the clouds whose sky ships were spoken of in folklore, were arrested, and a bishop named Agobard argued that the whole thing could not possibly be real, according to the philosopher Jason Jorjani. Jorjani tells it without naming a source, linking it to the researcher Jacques Vallée, who has written about Magonia, and casts Agobard as an early rationalist explaining away what may have been encounters like modern UFO reports.
